text:
Watermelon (ដំណាំឪឡឹក) is a vine (creeping/climbing) crop that belongs to the cucurbit (gourd) family, similar to cucumber. It can be grown in many types of soil, but grows best in sandy loam soil that has good aeration and drainage — soil that does not hold excess water for long, since standing water easily damages the roots.

Watermelon can be grown up to three times per year in Cambodia when irrigation water is reliably available for the dry-season crops; outside of this, it is commonly grown as a rainy-season crop that depends on rainfall. It is an economically important vegetable/fruit crop widely cultivated by Cambodian farmers for both home consumption and sale in local and regional markets.
